label: The MIRROR_2 image of the actual world has the opposite handedness
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the feature H (global spatial handedness) holds at the CPT image τ.image w (MIRROR_2) exactly when it fails at w. The CPT image is a different arrangement. CPT conjugation reverses spatial handedness (as spatial reflection P also does). Two denials are distinct. (i) Relationalism about global spatial orientation rejects a global handedness feature, so no H of this kind differs between w and its CPT image; it denies this premise but does not make the CPT image the actual world, since that image also has matter and antimatter exchanged and its history reversed, which spatial-orientation relationalism does not identify away. (ii) Identity with the whole CPT image (τ.image w = w) also denies it, but needs an additional explicit identification commitment beyond (i): that charge conjugation and time reversal are identified away as well (charge/time-reversal relationalism), or that CPT-related worlds are qualitatively identical as wholes. Fork clause 4 derives the identity only under collapse, essence-grounded possibility, factivity and preservation, not from relationalism.
